items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I'm trying to think of his name -- Brooks -- Ralph Bunch and what's his name (Ed) Brooks.

ctx.x: No, no -- who were they -- what's the name of that act -- it's a team, I can't think of the name of it. Anyway, see, the thing that you're forgetting that Buck and Bubbles are the pioneers for the negroes' publicity, negroes playing on the stages throughout the United States. You forget that point, dontcha. You don't realize there weren't no negroes in nothing, they got 'em anyhow but they didn't

get 'em all of a sudden -- gradually. You didn't go to the Palace Theater in those days 'cause you wanted to go in there, they got in there gradually. But you had to be somebody to get in there. That is in the world of entertainment. Not because your name was Ralph Bunche or what's his name -- I'm trying to think of his name -- Brooks -- Ralph Bunch and what's his name (Ed) Brooks.
